boards.title: Options and short help
boards.use: Reusable settings/help overlay, with audio, reduced motion, readable text and the prepare/save/watch loop.
boards.note: Guide accepted with minor text/icon details governed by the written design. Native source assets and exact geometry remain separate.

boards.title: Owned-rooster selection and paging
boards.use: Inline selection, truthful life/pending badges, bounded paging/search and Hatch another. No standalone collection dashboard.
boards.note: This is a selector-layout guide. Use RP-01 for fixture placement; replace any play-as wording with Choose rooster. Choosing another NFT does not steer an NPC.

boards.title: Expanded status and read-only object detail
boards.use: Saved values, condition deadline and remaining object life; object inspection explains state without commanding the NPC.
boards.note: Guide accepted with minor text/icon details governed by the written design. Native source assets and exact geometry remain separate.

boards.title: Wallet selection and wrong network
boards.use: Entry connection and network correction without claiming a token is already owned or charging for a day.
boards.note: The generic installed-wallet choice acquired a fox-like icon. Use a neutral or actually verified supported connector icon in the build.

boards.title: Session authentication and expiry
boards.use: Message-only session authentication before scarce quote holds; declining preserves the draft and makes no payment/request.
boards.note: Back is a valid escape preserving the draft, despite its subdued visual style; it must remain active.

boards.title: Mint approval and submitted transaction
boards.use: An unsent approval differs from a submitted transaction. Track the existing operation and block duplicate Hatch.
boards.note: Pre-mint backgrounds and any decorative need meters are representative. Hide/mark them as demo until ownership/identity is actually confirmed.

boards.title: Owned token and first-day retry
boards.use: First-day failure retains the NFT/starter stock. Fresh retry is not another mint, starter grant or ordinary delivery.
boards.note: Only a canonically Failed/Expired and released first-day attempt enables this fresh retry. It keeps the same starter inventory and no ordinary delivery.

boards.title: Optional fee detail and stale quote
boards.use: Fee detail is voluntary. Quote refresh preserves selection; a positive amount never becomes Free or $0.00.
boards.note: The tiny ETH breakdown is illustrative arithmetic, not an observed network quote. Ordinary care keeps the estimate subtle and fee detail optional.

boards.title: No choice yet and deterministic receipt
boards.use: Empty/unsupported model telemetry is explained honestly. Reading does not buy an invented choice.
boards.note: The recorded idle background blends a fridge into the bedroom and the birth meters are generic. Preserve the card semantics; populate the room from RP-01 and health100/needs80 from the actual save.

boards.title: One and two selected delivery types
boards.use: Both smaller kits remain valid; proposed additions remain separate from unchanged stored stock.
boards.note: Catalog focus/highlight is approximate. The selected-delivery row shows one or two additions; stock stays2water/2bread/1bandage before acceptance.

boards.title: Urgent warnings and enlarged text
boards.use: Keep all game-day deadlines discoverable through one vertical scroll flow; this drawing is not executed accessibility QA.
boards.note: Treat this as a reflow/reading-order concept. Exact 200% font layout, scrolling and focus require implementation rather than tracing the image. Background fixtures and meter fills are approximate. Actual Food deficit begins at nutrition0 and must clear above30; do not infer canonical state from the illustrated meter. Keep all warnings and deadlines visible.

boards.title: Operating capacity and maintenance
boards.use: An admission pause is different from death or the token trial cap. Accepted jobs and remaining committed days remain separate facts.
boards.note: This living testnet example has one committed day and two remaining. The pause concerns operating capacity/maintenance, not the NFT trial-day cap.

boards.title: Interrupted chain read and version recovery
boards.use: Unknown reads preserve last-known state. Unsupported presentation/version uses a safe compact outcome and compatible update path.
boards.note: Use friendly update/reload copy in the build; version/read trouble cannot erase the save or enable another request from uncertainty.

boards.title: Paused playback and transaction details
boards.use: Pause affects the film only. Owner request and backend final-save transactions have separate inspectable records.
boards.note: Recorded playback can show level3/day4 while current final details show level4/saved4. That difference is intentional.

boards.title: Initial loading and missing artwork
boards.use: A neutral bootstrap view and text-first asset fallback avoid fake ownership or a paid replay/day as repair.
boards.note: Guide accepted with minor text/icon details governed by the written design. Native source assets and exact geometry remain separate.
